column4: A word, a talk, a matter.
Staying, living; also the participle 'who is, that stays'.
To, in order to; ending that makes an infinitive.
Lord, master; used for God and Jesus.
Give; short form of dibo, dibi.
Present of di: gives, is giving.
Judgment, a decision about right and wrong.
Drink; in kha-luwa, food and drink.

column4: Said, told; verbal form of koi.
John, a man's name in the Bible.
Not staying, without; negative of thaka.
To gather, collect; used with koi or hoi.
Variant of bole: to, in order to.
Happened, became; verbal form of hoi.
Marks continuing action, like is or was doing.
column13: doubtful: only seen as aux after verb

column4: A shout or cry, a loud call.
To make or build; short form of bonai.
Apostle, one of Jesus' sent followers.
Meeting; perhaps lok kori, to meet.
As many as, as much as.
Time, occasion, as in sat bar.
Closing; with kori, to shut or close.
The other side; with hoi, to cross or pass.
Kept, placed; verbal form of rakhi.
Mary, a woman's name in the Bible.
Past of thaki: was staying, was.
Obeyed, accepted; verbal form of mani.
Right, as in the right hand.
To get; short form of pai.
Do not do; negative command of kori.
Go; short form of jai, also used after other verbs.
Getting up, rising; verbal form of uthi.
Past of di: had given, gave.
Running, driving, ruling; verbal form of cholai.
Having given; used in mon dikena, with attention.
Life; in jee uthi, to rise alive.
column13: doubtful: only seen in jee uthi

column4: An attempt or effort; with kori, to try.
To do for someone; kori with di.
If gave; di with -ile, if or when giving.
Perhaps a form of pai: to get or feel.
If not done; negative of korile.
Does not give; negative of diye.
Macedonia, a region in the Bible.
To feed; short form of khilai.
Asia, a region in the Bible.
Past of uthi jai: got up, rose.
